v3.hero.title:
Press Play.
Keep every frame.
v3.hero.lead: Nightfall is a free launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition, built for max FPS. Modrinth and CurseForge are built in, every mod is stored once on your disk, and a share code gives a friend your exact setup.
v3.dl.elsewhere: Nightfall runs on Windows and Linux PCs. Open this page on your computer to download it.
v3.spec.title: Spec sheet
v3.feat.title: Twelve things it does well.
v3.feat.sub: Each one can be switched off, and none of them runs in the background while you play.
v3.fps.title: Built for max FPS. Then measured.
v3.fps.lead: The launcher gets out of the way while you play, and every in-game feature has a cost budget: if one takes more than 2% of a frame, it gets optimized before it ships.
v3.fps.p1.d: One click adds Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore and other performance mods that match your version and loader.
v3.fps.p2.d: Each version gets the Java it needs, sensible memory and garbage-collector flags we tested against a standard launch.
v3.fps.p3.d: While the game runs, the launcher stops its animations and background work, and it never installs an update mid-game.
v3.fps.p4.d: Render distance, FPS limit, VSync and graphics are never copied between instances, so a heavy pack can't slow down a light one.
v3.fps.p5.d: On laptops, Nightfall asks Windows to use the faster GPU, and Performance check shows which one the game will get.
v3.fps.m.title: What we measured
v3.fps.m1: Companion mod with every feature on
v3.fps.m2: Our launch settings vs a standard CurseForge-style launch
v3.fps.note: Measured on 25 October 2026 on our test machine: a 54-mod Fabric 1.21.1 pack, fixed seed and camera path, 3 rounds. Your FPS depends mostly on your graphics card, its driver and your video settings.

v3.ts.title: Troubleshooting
v3.ts.sub: Fixes for the problems people hit most, in order. Still stuck? Paste your log into Crash help or ask on Discord.
v3.ts.q1: The game won't start or closes right away
v3.ts.a1: Open the instance's console in Nightfall and paste the last lines into Crash help. It names the most likely cause. Usually it's a mod made for a different Minecraft version or loader, or a missing dependency.
v3.ts.q2: My FPS is lower than in another launcher
v3.ts.a2: Run Performance check on the instance. It shows the graphics card, Java and memory the game will use. On a laptop, make sure it shows your dedicated GPU. Then compare the in-game video settings: render distance and VSync matter most. If it still looks wrong, post the screenshot on Discord.
v3.ts.q3: Windows says the installer isn't safe
v3.ts.a3: The installer isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about it. Click More info, then Run anyway. You can check its SHA-256 on the download page first.
v3.ts.a4: Some antivirus tools flag new apps that aren't signed. Download only from this site or our GitHub releases and check the SHA-256. If it matches, you can add an exception.
v3.ts.q5: The screen is black or white when the game opens
v3.ts.a5: Update your graphics driver from your GPU maker's website. If you use shaders, try the instance without them. On a laptop, check which GPU Performance check shows.
v3.ts.a6: Nightfall shares keybinds, controls and audio between instances. An instance can keep its own settings instead: turn that on in the instance's settings. FPS options are never shared.
v3.ts.a7: Sign-in is built into the launcher, but Mojang has to approve Nightfall before it can be used. We'll announce it on Discord as soon as it's approved.

v3.fp.new032sub: Organize big modpacks, switch versions safely and start new instances from your own setup.
v3.n.mods.d: Filter mods by tag, then turn them on or off, update or remove them together, with a preview before updating.
v3.n.version.d: Every mod is swapped for a compatible build. Mods without one are listed and turned off, and a backup makes it undoable.
v3.n.templates.d: Save an instance as a template for new ones, and update a modpack from a newer file while keeping your configs and worlds.
v3.n033.1: Newest Java 21 (Temurin) and a fuller starting memory allocation, for smoother FPS.
v3.n033.2: Your FPS cap is never overwritten; a fairer Compare FPS and a CurseForge-identical test launch.
v3.n033.3: Turn off all HUD with one switch or a key, and get exactly what you had back.
v3.n033.4: New instances start clean: transfer all your settings from another instance, or start fresh.
v3.n033.5: Fixed: Customize no longer changes your GUI scale.
v3.n034.1: A new in-game menu with categories, pages and search, now on 1.8.9, 1.12.2 and 1.16–1.19 too.
v3.n034.2: The in-game menu is translated into all 23 languages, on every version.
v3.n034.3: Customize: 55 free fonts with a live preview, downloaded only when you pick one (Minecraft 1.16+).
v3.n034.4: Title-screen backgrounds on every version: a colour, your own picture or a free Openverse photo with credit.
v3.n034.5: Kids mode gets Customize too, with online picture search off by default.
v3.fp.new035sub: A new in-game menu, your own look, and recommended mods for packs you already have.
v3.n.menu035.d: Categories, pages and search, on every version from 1.8.9, in 23 languages.
v3.n.customize035.d: 55 free fonts and title-screen backgrounds, including free Openverse photos.
v3.n.recsadd.d: Recommended mods matched to your instance, with a preview, a backup and one-click undo.
v3.n035.1: Recommendations: add a set to an instance you already have, with compatible instances listed first.
v3.n035.2: Every mod is matched to that instance's Minecraft version and loader; ones already there or that clash are skipped.
v3.n035.3: See exactly what changes before anything is installed, including dependencies.
v3.n035.4: A backup is made first, and Undo puts the instance back in one click.
v3.n035.5: 17 more in-game menu texts translated in every language.
v3.n036.1: Updates download in the background and install quietly when you close the launcher, with no setup wizard.
v3.n036.2: If the launcher stays open, a small card offers Restart now or Later.
v3.n036.3: Never during a game: the update waits until Minecraft closes.
v3.n036.4: After an update, a card shows the new version and what changed.
v3.n036.5: Settings: “Install updates automatically” (on by default) and “Check now”. The Linux AppImage updates itself too.
v3.n036.6: Fixed: customizing no longer resets view bobbing, damage tilt, chat and accessibility settings.
v3.n037.1: Put instances in folders (PvP, Modpacks, Old versions…) right from their card.
v3.n037.2: Folders appear as filters next to the instance search.
v3.n037.3: Starred instances stay at the top.
v3.n038.1: World manager: rename worlds and export them as a .zip.
v3.n038.2: Every backup is listed; restore it as a copy or replace the current world.
v3.n038.3: Deleting a world keeps a backup, so mistakes can be undone.

v3.nv0.3.9.2: See memory, garbage collector and performance mods before and after.
v3.nv0.3.9.3: A backup is made first, with one-click Undo.
